response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and CI/CD, but his resume shows no evidence of people management, direct reports, or formal team leadership responsibilities across his 15+ year career. The role explicitly requires 2+ years of people management and 3+ years in a technical leadership role with performance management duties, which are not demonstrated here despite his impressive technical breadth and mentorship-adjacent activities (workshops, talks, open source).
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, test runners, CI infrastructure, and testing frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium courses)
Strong technical breadth across languages/platforms (web, mobile, embedded, backend) and system design
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentorship through workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct reports anywhere in 15+ year career
Title trajectory (Senior/Staff Software Developer) suggests IC track, not management track, with no manager or lead titles
No mention of organizational change leadership, performance reviews, or team roadmap ownership required for this role

key_factors.factor: No formal technical leadership/management title or scope
Strong developer tools and testing infrastructure background
